name: Mystery Music Show: King of Mask Singer
description: Competitors are given elaborate masks to wear in order to conceal their identity, thus removing factors such as popularity, career and age that could lead to prejudiced voting. In the first round, a pair of competitors sing the same song, while in the second and third rounds they each sing a solo song. After the First Generation, the winner of the Third Round goes on to challenge the Mask King, and is either eliminated or replaces the previous Mask King through live voting. The identities of the singers are not revealed unless they have been eliminated.

videos.title: Episode 500 - 10th Anniversary Special Part 01
videos.overview:
500th Episode & 10th anniversary Special

10 special performances based on ten different key words representing this show.  Get ready! Everyone's invited to the 10th anniversary of The King of Mask Singer, the mystery music show that's all about true musical battles, free from prejudice. You'll witness an unrivaled vocal powerhouse whose unique sound sends shivers down your spine from the very first note. Don't miss special appearances from past champions, who've prepared an unforgettable stage to mark this incredible 10-year milestone

videos.title: Episode 510
videos.overview: Variety sensation Mimi of OH MY GIRL joins the judging panel! Find out how she brought the house down with laughter on King of Mask Singer. Plus, a masked singer with a surprising link to the "Korean Hulk", Ma Dong Seok, stuns everyone by revealing a special story!

videos.title: Episode 511
videos.overview: Who is the masked singer that made "musical genius" Yoon Sang completely flustered? Who is this star whose pristine voice melted everyone's hearts? "That performance hit me like a powerful gust of wind!" With a performance so electrifying it gave everyone goosebumps from beginning to end, who is this master vocalist that's now a top contender for the crown?

videos.title: Episode 512
videos.overview: The global musical star Michael Lee visits as a judge! Which contestant's charming voice got him instant fans from the very first line? Could it be a singer with a close connection to the "Original Dancing Diva", Uhm Jung Hwa? Which masked singer shocked the judges with a special story about her? A new masked singer has appeared as "Korea's Walt Disney". Let's see if he can actually break the record for the lowest number of votes.

videos.title: Episode 513
videos.overview: Hanbin from ZEROBASEONE and Mad Clown give some hints about who Yippie Colombia and Red Ruby can be. Who is this expert singer with soaring high notes, whom Hye Jin thinks might be a student of hers? Who is the masked singer with a powerful voice and a sorrowful sentiment who can pull off any genre? Will Soulful Piano be able to keep her Throne for the second time against a new contender?

videos.title: Episode 514 (Chuseok Special)
videos.overview: Who is the mysterious masked singer who earned the full support of actor Park Sung Woong, known for his intense charisma? The masked singer's unexpected connection to a celebrity surprises the panel! And guess whose sweet, soulful voice melts everyone's hearts, reminding us of SS501, the second-generation "flower boy" idol group!

videos.title: Episode 515
videos.overview: After two consecutive wins, Soulful Piano is after her third! What's this? A mask from the globally beloved "KPop Demon Hunters" takes the stage and touches the hearts of all the judges. Another mask, dubbed an all-rounder artist by past King 10cm, sparks curiosity as their voice warmly envelopes the crowd`. Another mask is revealed to have special ties to singer Song Ga In and captivates the entire audience with an explosive performance. The intense battle for the throne continues!

videos.title: Episode 516 (Autumn Special)
videos.overview: As the new King, Perfect Aim Marksman defends his crown before the audience and the judges. A mysterious contestant with a special connection to actor Lee Jong-suk stirs up excitement and fuels the panel's guesses. From another mask's powerful performance reminiscent of Super Junior's Kyuhyun to a show-stopping special stage, this episode delivers warmth and unforgettable moments perfect for the arrival of the chilly autumn weather.

videos.title: Episode 517
videos.overview: Perfect Aim Marksman presents breathtaking vocals again in another attempt at defending the Throne. One mask has an impressive record, fighting for the top spot on the charts alongside IU and IVE. Which mask is behind the '90s mega hit, bringing the studio back to the good old days with a nostalgic performance? Another mask's bubbly charm brings an infectious smile to all viewers. Lastly, one mask has special ties to third-gen idols and is making a historical 10-year comeback.

videos.title: Episode 518
videos.overview: Perfect Aim Marksman takes another shot at defending his throne with to-die-for vocals. Nine-time King, Jeong Joon Il, makes an appearance as a guest judge and wows everyone with his sharp insight. One challenger's sweet vocal tone is reminiscent of BTS's Jimin, sending chills throughout the entire audience. From one mask's surprising connection to actor Cho Jung Seok to another with a voice similar to Lee Seok Hoon, the stage is enveloped in a nostalgic autumn atmosphere.

videos.title: Episode 519
videos.overview: Perfect Aim Marksman goes for a three-peat against more formidable challengers. Several masks share connections to well-established singers. One has special ties to the father of Korean RnB, Moon Myung Jin. One is considered a "savior" by legendary balladeer Jung Seung Hwan. And another shares a shocking encounter with the original sexy diva, Uhm Jung Hwa. With soulful tones and overwhelming vocal prowess, the masks take the stage with eyes on the throne. Who will come out on top?

videos.title: Episode 520
videos.overview: After securing a third win, Perfect Aim Marksman returns to defend his longstanding run as King. The guest judges are joined by legendary balladeer and five-time King, Yangpa, to watch the new masks duke it out. Some masks share connections to notable artists like SOYEON, BIBI, and IU, while one's clear yet powerful voice is reminiscent of S.E.S's Bada. The masks spare nothing in preparing breathtaking performances for their shot at the throne.

videos.title: The Final King of Mask Singer Part 01
videos.overview: The first-ever "The Final King of Masked Singers" is underway to tie the ribbon on 10 years of incredible performances and to decide the Final King. Other-worldly vocals, goosebump-inducing stage presence, and an electric atmosphere like this can only be seen here as past Kings rock the stage once more to claim the coveted Final Gold Mask. The entire studio is captivated by every note sung. In the end, who will rise as the Final King?

videos.title: The Final King of Mask Singers Part 02
videos.overview: The new year starts with the fiery Final Round of The Final King of Masked Singers, where the nine Kings battle it out for the Gold Mask. In a tournament-style match, the winner keeps advancing until they reach the top. However, the current King, Perfect Aim Marksman, gets the advantage in choosing the order! With each round, each past King demolishes the stage and leaves the audience in awe with unprecedented performances. In the end, who will emerge as the Final King?
